perks.name: Afterimage Protocol
perks.description: Boost leaves a holographic decoy for 1.5 seconds. It draws nearby basic enemies within 600 cm. Internal cooldown: 6 seconds; bosses ignore the taunt.

perks.name: Ward Recharge
perks.description: Every 25 essence points collected restore shield equal to 15% of maximum health. Shield cap: 30% of maximum health. Shield absorbs damage before health and cannot negate the fixed health cost of a challenge.

perks.description: Boost emits a 350 cm energy ring dealing 35 base damage and pushing basic enemies back. Internal cooldown: 6 seconds. Bosses take damage but resist displacement.
